englishUI.scope: An enrolled fictional contributor used the production request form. The visible labels persisted after changing 2 packs to 3 and 8 per pack to 6. Done dismissed each keyboard. Purpose, destination and exclusions exposed their explicit accessibility names and kept their filled values. Request review preserved the original words and edited quantities. Cancel left zero submitted requests in the fixture.

priorUI.scope: The quantity-only candidate passed the numeric fields, both Done actions and request review before adding captions to the text fields.

The expanded run reached both quantity edits. It failed when XCTest could not find the filled multiline purpose field by its accessible name. The final code assigns explicit labels and identifiers to the purpose, destination and exclusions fields.

compiledDebug.scope: Ordinary arm64 Debug, with the independently reviewed widget guard included. Executable, assets, privacy, environment and embedded extensions passed verification.

compiledRelease.scope: The unsigned arm64 Release archive includes the capture field edits and widget guard. Executable, assets, privacy, environment and embedded extensions passed bundle checks.

spanishLargeTextFirstAttempt.scope: The app exposed the localized per-pack field with value 8 at the largest accessibility text size. The harness’s scroll gesture left that control outside the viewport, so the edit and keyboard checks did not run.

spanishLargeTextFollowUp.scope: A collection-scoped scroll in the test harness ended on the Spanish request warning at the largest accessibility text size. XCTest could not find the per-pack field at that position. Editing and keyboard dismissal remain unverified on this device and text setting.

spanishLargeTextReviewStart.scope: At the largest accessibility text size the structured review opens with the original wording visible without scrolling. The Spanish fixture found pack count 2, changed the usable amount from 8 to 6, closed the keyboard with Listo, read the lunch purpose and milk exclusion, and cancelled with zero submitted requests.

ordinaryDebugTests.scope: Fourteen structured capture model tests and two shopping-list UI journeys passed. The UI covered reopening a cancelled capture and returning to the original draft before merging a duplicate across restart.

committedRegression.scope: The repository's guarded contributor UI test verified that the original Spanish wording is visible near the top of the viewport when the structured review opens.

accessibilityUnitMenu.scope: The stacked label and menu use the full width. At the largest text size the Spanish accessibility tree reported Unidad por paquete as the button’s name and Unidades as its current value. A tap on the visible control opened the system menu. Choosing Gramos and then Unidades changed the accessible value each time. The original wording, edited pack quantity, purpose and milk exclusion remained readable, and Cancel left zero submitted requests.

ordinaryMinimumOS.scope: The ordinary Debug app passed bundle verification. Its iOS 17 model run covered structured capture, spelling, contributor requests, and widget startup and route isolation.

priorAttempts.observation: The visual layout stacked the label, but the native picker exposed a duplicated accessibility name.

The replacement exposed the distinct name and selected value. XCTest reported the menu button as non-hittable despite its visible frame. The passing harness tapped inside the visible frame and checked actual choices and values.
